article.title: Administration with exception.
article.content: Whenever the nature of the case requires that an exception be made, letters of administration shall be granted subject to such exception.
article.html:
256Administration with exception.

Section 256 · Part IX · Chapter II · page 74 of the Act

Whenever the nature of the case requires that an exception be made, letters of administration shall be granted subject to such exception.
